step3.title: Create the comparison
step3.body: Start by creating the comparison year that matches your invoices. Use the current tax year.
step3.hint: Once the year exists, you’ll be able to add products to compare.

step10.title: Edit your comparison
step10.body: Use this button to add or edit the products you want to compare for this year.
step10.hint: Click “View” now to open the comparison editor.

step15.title: Generate your annual report
step15.body: Click here to generate (or regenerate) the detailed annual report for this comparison year.
step15.hint: Once it’s ready, you’ll be taken to the printable report page.
